categories.main_business_segments: Lizhong Sitong Light Alloys Group Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: functional intermediate alloy new materials, recycled casting aluminum alloy materials, and aluminum alloy wheels. The company has a complete industrial chain covering alloy material research and development, manufacturing, recycling, and automotive lightweight components production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including low-pressure casting, casting spinning, solid-state forging, liquid forging, and differential pressure casting. It has strong R&D capabilities with over 964 patents and multiple national and international research centers. Key innovations include high-strength heat-free treatment alloys, brazable die-cast aluminum alloys, high conductivity aluminum alloys, and green low-carbon aluminum alloy wheels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lizhong serves major global automotive manufacturers and retailers, supplying aluminum alloy wheels and lightweight chassis components. Its products are also used in aerospace, high-speed rail, electronics, power equipment, consumer electronics, and packaging industries. The company’s customers span North America, South America, Europe, Japan, Korea, Middle East, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with production bases in Hebei, Tianjin, Shandong, Guangdong, Hubei, Jilin, Anhui, Chongqing, and other provinces. It also has overseas facilities and sales networks in the United States, Mexico, Brazil, Thailand, South Korea, the United Kingdom, and Hong Kong, supporting a global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lizhong operates across the aluminum alloy supply chain, including upstream raw material processing (recycled aluminum and intermediate alloys), midstream alloy manufacturing, and downstream automotive component production, particularly aluminum alloy wheels and lightweight chassis parts. It also engages in resource recycling and circular economy initiatives.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation focusing on new material development such as heat-free treatment alloys, brazable alloys, high conductivity alloys, and aluminum-based rare earth functional intermediate alloys. It invests heavily in R&D to support automotive lightweighting, green low-carbon production, and expanding applications in emerging industries like new energy vehicles, robotics, aerospace, and semiconductors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aluminum alloy products including casting alloys, intermediate alloys, and automotive aluminum wheels. The company also earns processing fees from alloy casting services and provides customized technical support and product development services to automotive OEMs and aftermarket retailers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lizhong is one of the largest and most comprehensive aluminum alloy companies globally, holding a leading position in functional intermediate alloys, recycled casting aluminum, and automotive aluminum wheels in China. It competes with domestic and international aluminum alloy producers and automotive component suppliers, leveraging its integrated industrial chain and technological advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately 27.25 billion RMB, representing a 16.61% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about 707 million RMB. The company has shown steady growth driven by expanding production capacity, overseas market development, and increased demand for lightweight automotive components.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lizhong differentiates itself through a fully integrated industrial chain from alloy material R&D to automotive component manufacturing, strong technological innovation, and global production and sales network. Its products emphasize high performance, low cost, and green low-carbon manufacturing, meeting stringent quality and environmental standards, which earns trust from leading global automotive manufacturers.
